blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Recognizing the heightened vulnerability of schools in Geographically Isolated and Disadvantaged Areas during disasters, the Pisompongan Integrated School (PIS) in Midsalip town, Zamboanga del Sur, conducted over the weekend a two-day emergency response training, transforming teachers, students, and community volunteers into first responders. Pisompongan Integrated School is 20 kilometers away from the Midsalip town center. Located far from the town center where emergency services and communication are often delayed, the remote school hosted the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management training to ensure local residents can manage life-threatening incidents on their own when help is out […]...
